94     def verify(self, claim):
  95         claim = claim.strip().rstrip('.').strip()
  96         # Full clauses only: modifiers, conjunctions, and negation do not match.
  97         match = re.fullmatch(r'(.+?) (?:is|was) an? (actor|actress|singer|writer|politician|director|footballer|musician|scientist|artist|dancer)', claim, re.I)
  98         if match:
  99             entity = self.subject(match[1], human=True)
 100             if entity is None:
 101                 return None, 'v2_ambiguous_or_unresolved_human'
 102             for value in values(entity, 'P106'):
 103                 if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('id') and self.named_match(value['id'], match[2]):
 104                     return 0, 'v2_P106_exact_occupation'
 105             return None, 'v2_occupation_not_matched'
 106         match = re.fullmatch(r'(.+?) is a member of (.+)', claim, re.I)
 107         if match:
 108             entity = self.subject(match[1])
 109             if entity is None:
 110                 return None, 'v2_ambiguous_or_unresolved_subject'
 111             for value in values(entity, 'P463'):
 112                 if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('id') and self.named_match(value['id'], match[2]):
 113                     return 0, 'v2_P463_exact_membership'
 114             return None, 'v2_membership_not_matched'
 115         match = re.fullmatch(r'(.+?) (was born|died) in (?:the )?(\d{4})(s)?', claim, re.I)
 116         if match:
 117             entity = self.subject(match[1], human=True)
 118             if entity is None:
 119                 return None, 'v2_ambiguous_or_unresolved_human'
 120             prop = 'P569' if match[2].lower() == 'was born' else 'P570'
 121             year, decade = int(match[3]), bool(match[4])
 122             if decade and year % 10:
 123                 return None, 'v2_invalid_decade'
 124             dates = values(entity, prop)
 125             if len(dates) != 1 or not isinstance(dates[0], dict):
 126                 return None, 'v2_missing_or_multiple_dates'
 127             value = dates[0]
 128             date = re.fullmatch(r'\+(\d+)-\d{2}-\d{2}T00:00:00Z', value.get('time', ''))
 129             if (date and value.get('precision', 0) >= (8 if decade else 9)
 130                     and value.get('before', 0) == value.get('after', 0) == 0
 131                     and value.get('calendarmodel', '').endswith('/Q1985727')):
 132                 actual = int(date[1])
 133                 if year <= actual <= year + (9 if decade else 0):
 134                     return 0, 'v2_' + prop + '_date_match'
 135             return None, 'v2_date_not_matched'
 136         # Avoid sending temporal expressions to place rules.
 137         if re.search(r'\b(?:born|died) in (?:the )?(?:\d|\w+ties\b)', claim, re.I):
 138             return None, 'v2_unsupported_temporal_expression'
 139         return super().verify(claim)

73     def verify(self, claim):
  74         for pattern, property_id in PATTERNS:
  75             match = pattern.fullmatch(claim.strip())
  76             if not match:
  77                 continue
  78             subject, object_text = match.group(1).strip(), match.group(2).strip()
  79             subject_id = self.search_exact(subject)
  80             if not subject_id:
  81                 return None, "unresolved_or_ambiguous_subject"
  82             entity = self.entity(subject_id)
  83             statements = entity.get("claims", {}).get(property_id, [])
  84             ids = set()
  85             for statement in statements:
  86                 if statement.get("rank") == "deprecated":
  87                     continue
  88                 mainsnak = statement.get("mainsnak", {})
  89                 value = mainsnak.get("datavalue", {}).get("value", {})
  90                 if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("id"):
  91                     ids.add(value["id"])
  92             if not ids:
  93                 return None, "no_structured_property"
  94             # Require one unique value to avoid disputed or multi-valued facts.
  95             if len(ids) != 1:
  96                 return None, "multiple_property_values"
  97             place = self.entity(next(iter(ids)))
  98             names = [place.get("labels", {}).get("en", {}).get("value", "")]
  99             names += [alias.get("value", "") for alias in
 100                       place.get("aliases", {}).get("en", [])]
 101             if normalize(object_text) in {normalize(name) for name in names if name}:
 102                 return 0, f"wikidata_{property_id}_exact_match"
 103             # Wikidata is open-world; a non-match is NOT sufficient for REFUTES.
 104             return None, "object_not_matched"
 105         return None, "unsupported_claim_pattern"
